directAnswer: To check your smart speaker, ensure it is powered on and connected to Wi-Fi, then use the companion app or voice commands to test its functionality.
summary: This guide provides steps to check the functionality of your smart speaker across different platforms.

sections.heading: Initial Setup Check
sections.body: Ensure your smart speaker is plugged in and the power indicator is lit. Verify that it is connected to your home Wi-Fi network.

sections.heading: Using the Companion App
sections.body: Open the smart speaker's companion app on your smartphone. Check for any notifications or updates that may affect performance.

sections.heading: Testing Voice Commands
sections.body: Try using voice commands to test the speaker's responsiveness. Common commands include asking for the weather or playing music.

steps.title: Power On the Speaker
steps.detail: Make sure the speaker is plugged into a power outlet and turned on.

steps.title: Connect to Wi-Fi
steps.detail: Ensure the speaker is connected to your home Wi-Fi network through the companion app.

steps.title: Update Firmware
steps.detail: Check the companion app for any firmware updates that may enhance performance.

steps.title: Test Functionality
steps.detail: Use voice commands or the app to test various functions like music playback or smart home controls.

faqs.question: What should I do if my smart speaker is not responding?
faqs.answer: Try restarting the speaker and checking the Wi-Fi connection. If the issue persists, consult the manufacturer's support.

faqs.question: How can I reset my smart speaker?
faqs.answer: Refer to the manufacturer's instructions for resetting your specific model, as the process may vary.

faqs.question: Can I check the speaker's status remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, if your speaker is connected to the internet, you can check its status via the companion app.

caveats: Steps may vary based on the specific model and manufacturer of the smart speaker.
